name: agents-benchmark-1.0.1
description: Agents Benchmark 1.0.1 evaluates the capabilities of agentic language models to perform multi-step, multi-turn tasks involving planning, tool usage, and stateful decision-making. It measures how reliably models can complete end-to-end tasks that require chaining actions and using external tools or memory. The benchmark emphasizes task success and robustness across varied interactive scenarios.
reputation: A relatively new dataset for evaluating agentic behaviors with growing attention in agent and tool-use research communities but not yet widely standardized.
